title: CPCLDETECTOR: KNOWLEDGE ENHANCEMENT AND ALIGNMENT SELECTION FOR CHINESE PATRONIZING AND CONDESCENDING LANGUAGE DETECTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical detection of patronizing and condescending language (PCL), which is characterized as implicitly discriminatory toxic speech. While the topic has social and ethical implications regarding the treatment of vulnerable groups, the research does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical systems.
